t: This is the Silver Jubilee Crystal Crown, a sculpture in perspex by Arthur Fleischmann. It has stood at St Katharine Docks since the Silver Jubilee of Elizabeth the Second in 1977. A plaque nearby claims it is the largest solid block of acrylic in the world. Fleischmann was born in Slovakia and settled in London, and he pioneered the use of perspex in sculpture. Before London he spent time in Bali and in Australia, where he was at the centre of the Merioola Group. Look at how the clear material catches the light around you.
